description: Host stores and the exact chunked execution of ONE GroupRegLevelModel (design 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.6): new package inference/ with store.py (RamStore, DiskStore, size estimate, auto choice) and streaming.py (StreamedLevel: pass schedule P0-P12 for the deform task, P0-P6 + gathered linear decoder for rigid/affine; max_elements_per_image; chunk cap). Depends on FEAT-001 (GroupConvBlock.pre / conv_with_group_mean). No cascade orchestration yet (FEAT-003).
steps: Create inference/__init__.py (package docstring pointing to .agents/tasks/predict-script/design.md) and inference/store.py: class RamStore and DiskStore with the API alloc(name, shape, dtype), put(name, i0, chunk_np), get(name, i0, i1) -> np array, free(name), nbytes(), close() (DiskStore: numpy.lib.format.open_memmap(<dir>/<name>.npy, 'w+'); free deletes the file; close removes the directory; usable as a context manager so the directory is removed in `finally` also on error). dtype kept (float16 activations stay float16). Function estimate_store_gb(level, model_cfg, n, branches, trainable_dtype) implementing the design section 6 arithmetic (largest simultaneous stores of the pass schedule + x_in + v_raw + previous-level fields), and choose_store(kind, estimate_gb, store_dir) -> store: 'auto' = RAM iff estimate <= 0.7 x budget, budget = SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE (MB) if set else MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo (fallback: RAM with a WARNING if neither is readable); store_dir default $TMPDIR if set else <out>/_stream_tmp (caller passes it).

Create inference/streaming.py with max_elements_per_image(level, model_cfg, tasks, split_group_conv) -> (E_max, tensor_name): per-image element counts of every block input / group concat (2C when not split; the stem always concatenates [x, mean] = 2 channels) / output and the deform fields at the level shape data_loading.params.LEVEL_SHAPE[level], for the encoder (pool2 at level 1, pool3 at levels 2/1, strides l4-l6 = 2), the deform decoder concat(up(x), skip) per stage with ModelConfig.resolved_decoder_widths(), and (linear) the encoder only. chunk_cap(level, model_cfg, tasks) = floor((2**31 - 1) / E_max) using split_group_conv=True (the engine always uses the split form).

In inference/streaming.py implement class StreamedLevel(model, store, chunk, lean=True, record_fp16=True) for model.config.block == 'single' only (ValueError otherwise, design 2.3). Chunk boundaries = [(i0, min(i0 + chunk, n)) ...]; a chunk with k x E_max >= 2**31 is capped to chunk_cap with a logged WARNING and recorded in self.capped. One tf.function per (pass, chunk length) (at most two traces per pass). Primitives exactly as design 4.2: group block on a chunk = block.conv_with_group_mean(block.pre(x, training=False), mean, inner_clip=block.split_group); stem: pre is the identity (stem.pre_activation False), inner_clip False; non-group block (config B, block.group False): clip_fp16(block.conv(block.pre(x, False)), block.fp16_act_clip). Group means: S += reduce_sum(cast(pre(x_chunk), float32), 0, keepdims=True) over all chunks, mean = cast(S / N, pre dtype). Casts exactly as the model: x = cast(images, model.compute_dtype); decoder per stage cast(x, block.compute_dtype), up, concat([x, cast(skip, x.dtype)]); head: cast(x, svf_norm_act.compute_dtype), svf_head(svf_norm_act(., training=False)), cast float32.

StreamedLevel.deform(n, input_fn, prev_fn=None, sink=None) -> dict: input_fn(i0, i1) returns this level's float32 MODEL INPUT chunk [k, X, Y, Z, 1] (the caller's P0 producer: pooling / pre-warp); P0 stores it as 'x_in' (float32) and accumulates S_x; then P1-P11 as the design 4.3 table (stem never stored, recomputed from x_in and mean_x in P1, P2, P10, P11; stores l2..l6, d5, d4, d3, d2 freed as soon as consumed; d1 fused into P11; v_raw stored float32, S_v accumulated). P12 per chunk: v = v_raw - S_v / N; (u_res, u_inv_res) = diffeo.exp_and_inverse(v, model.config.integration_steps, lean=lean); if prev_fn: (U, U_inv) = prev_fn(i0, i1) and (u, u_inv) = diffeo.compose_cascade(U, U_inv, u_res, u_inv_res, lean=lean), else u = u_res. If sink is None store 'u', 'u_inv' (float32) in the store and return their names; else call sink(i0, i1, {'u': u, 'u_inv': u_inv, 'v': v, 'v_raw': v_raw_chunk}) (GPU tensors) and store nothing. Return also stats {max_abs_v, chunks: list of boundaries per pass, fp16_max_abs per block (max |output| over chunks for float16 blocks, with ratio to 65504)}.

StreamedLevel.linear(n, input_fn, task) -> A_raw tensor [N, 4, 4] float32: P0-P6 only, keeping only the latest encoder store, then gather the bottleneck [N, 5, 7, 6, C] into one tensor and call model.linear_decoder(bottleneck, task=task, training=False)[0] once on all N (the model's own reductions, dense blocks, heads). The caller applies centering / compose_linear (FEAT-003).

Create tests/test_predict_store.py (TF-free part: RamStore / DiskStore put/get/free round trip incl. float16, DiskStore cleanup on an exception inside the context, estimate_store_gb monotone in n and ~40 GB for level 1 default widths N 101 deform-only fp16 (within 25 %), choose_store auto with SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE patched; no TF import) and extend tests/test_predict_streaming.py (TF): TestMaxElements (default widths: level 1 deform (440401920, d1 skip concat) and linear (220200960, stem output) -> cap 4 / 9 with split; with split_group_conv False the deform E_max is larger (group concat 2C) and the cap lower; hand counts at levels 4 and 2 as well) and TestStreamedLevel: random-weight TINY models (tests.runtime_helpers.tiny_config(deform_decoder=True, seed=1, integration_steps=3), tests.test_cascade.randomize(m, seed, 0.02)) at level 4 (N 3) and level 2 (N 3), task deform and rigid/affine, chunk sizes 1, 2 and N: streamed u, u_inv, v_raw vs model(x, 'deform', training=False) and streamed A_raw vs model(x, task, training=False)['A_raw'], float32 bounds S_stream (fields <= 1e-4 vox, A <= 1e-5) and mixed_float16 trainable model (S_fp16: fields <= 2e-2 vox max, <= 1e-3 mean); variants split_group_conv on/off, group_config 'A' and 'B', fp16_act_clip 100 under mixed_float16, deform_decoder_dtype 'float32_fine' under mixed_float16; lean True vs False on one level-2 deform case bitwise equal; block='residual' -> ValueError. Print measured maxima. Level 1 single-model case (TINY, float32, N 3, chunks 1 and 2, deform) runs entirely inside `with tf.device('/CPU:0'):` (model built inside the scope); skipTest only if no GPU is visible.
py3.8 ast check of inference/*.py and the new tests; commit locally on main ('predict-script FEAT-002: inference stores + exact streamed level engine'). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_predict_streaming passes: streamed == model call within S_stream (float32) / S_fp16 (mixed_float16) for every listed variant, chunk sizes 1, 2, N at levels 4 and 2, and level 1 on the CPU; maxima printed
max_elements_per_image hand counts match (level 1 default widths: deform 440401920 -> cap 4, linear 220200960 -> cap 9)
All new files parse with ast feature_version=(3, 8)

findings: FILES: inference/__init__.py (docstring only, no TF), inference/store.py (TF-free), inference/streaming.py, tests/test_predict_store.py (TF-free), tests/test_predict_streaming.py (FEAT-002 classes appended). No change in models/, runtime/, main.py, evaluation/. API FOR FEAT-003: store.RamStore() / DiskStore(store_dir) (DiskStore makes a private mkdtemp subdir 'bgr_stream_*' inside store_dir, so passing $TMPDIR is safe; close() removes the subdir and store_dir itself only if the store created it and it is empty; context manager); methods alloc/put/get/free/nbytes/peak_nbytes/names/close, `name in store`; names must match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+; RamStore.get returns a view, DiskStore.get a copy. store.choose_store(kind 'auto'|'ram'|'disk', estimate_gb, store_dir) -> store with store.choice = {requested, kind, estimate_gb, budget_gb, budget_source, directory} (for predict.json); memory_budget_gb(environ=None, meminfo='/proc/meminfo') -> (GB, 'SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE'|'MemAvailable') or (None, None) (SLURM MB treated as MiB). store.estimate_store_gb(level, model_cfg, n, branches (str or iterable of rigid/affine/deform/affine+deform), trainable_dtype 'float16'|'float32'): host inputs (image f32 + labels 2 B + mask 1 B per full-res voxel) + max over cascade levels 4..level (frozen float32) of the per-level peak (deform: simulated live activation stores of the pass schedule + x_in + v_raw + previous-level u/u_inv + own u/u_inv if a level follows; linear: x_in + two encoder stores; affine+deform adds the f32 resampled full-res source). Values (default widths, N 101): level 1 deform fp16 44.7 GB (the peak is the float32 frozen level-2 phase; level-1 phase alone 36.2), float32 54.2, affine+deform 47.5, affine 33.0. store.level_geometry(level, cfg) gives per-image (spatial, channels) of stem, l2..l6, d5..d1. streaming.max_elements_per_image(level, cfg, tasks, split_group_conv) -> (E, name), chunk_cap(level, cfg, tasks) (split form), INT32_LIMIT (module attribute; tests patch it). streaming.StreamedLevel(model, store, chunk, lean=True, record_fp16=True, prefix=None): DEVIATION (needed): extra kwarg prefix, default 'L<level>_', so levels sharing one store do not collide (stored outputs are 'L2_u', 'L2_u_inv'; the caller frees them). chunk None or <= 0 = whole group. deform(n, input_fn, prev_fn=None, sink=None) -> {'u', 'u_inv' (store names or None with a sink), 'stats'}; input_fn may return numpy or tensors (np.asarray float32, shape checked vs model.input_shape_level); prev_fn(i0, i1) -> (U, U_inv) at this level's voxels (numpy or tensors); sink(i0, i1, {u, u_inv, v, v_raw}) gets GPU tensors. linear(n, input_fn, task) -> A_raw tensor [n,4,4] (uncentered); stats in eng.last_stats (also set by deform). stats = {task, n, chunk, chunks {'P0'..'P12': [(i0, i1), ...]}, fp16_max_abs {block: {max_abs, ratio}} (only float16 blocks; {} under float32), max_abs_v (deform)}. P1 is skipped (absent in stats.chunks) when l2 has no group mean and nothing is recorded (config B float32). Linear frees x_in after P2 (design said after P6; nothing reads it later). Caps: eng.capped[task] = {requested, used, e_max, tensor} + logger WARNING (logger 'inference.streaming'). After every call the engine's own stores are freed (only the returned u/u_inv remain). HAND COUNTS (default widths): L1 deform split (440401920, 'd1 skip concat') cap 4, unsplit (880803840, 'd1 group concat') cap 2, L1 linear (220200960, 'stem output') cap 9; L4 deform split (24084480, 'd3 skip concat') cap 89, unsplit 48168960; L4 linear split (13762560, 'l3 output'), unsplit (27525120, 'l4 group concat'); L2 deform split (110100480, 'd2 skip concat') cap 19, unsplit 220200960; L2 linear (55050240, 'l2 output' / unsplit 'l2 group concat'). IMPORTANT FOR FEAT-003/004 LEVEL-1 CPU TESTS: TF 2.10 CPU Conv3D SEGFAULTS (rc 139, probed) on a [3,160,224,192,16] float32 input ([3,...,8], [2,...,16], [1,...,16] run); the TINY model's d1 conv at N 3 hits it (d2 8 + stem 8 channels) in the model's own call. The level-1 test therefore uses TINY with TINY_L1 = filters (4,16,16,16,16,16), decoder_widths (8,8,8,4,4) (tests/test_predict_streaming.TINY_L1; every full-res conv input <= 8 channels). Any level-1 CPU model at N 3 (FrozenChain + level-1 stage, trainer equivalence) must use these widths (or N <= 2). fp16 NOTE: streamed-vs-model fp16 differences scale with activation / field size (probe, L2 TINY fp16, inputs x30: |u| 4.4 vox -> max diff 0.025, mean 0.0014, above S_fp16; x100: 0.28 / 0.0037), so S_fp16 (2e-2 / 1e-3 abs vox) holds for small fields only; float32 is exact to ~1e-6. The fp16 clip test uses inputs x100 (all 11 fp16 blocks at the clip, asserted) with the SVF head scaled 1/100. tf.function retracing WARNINGs appear in the test log (many engines per process); harmless.
